newsitem.title: USA: Innotech Inc in Chinese joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Innotech Inc in Chinese joint venture.

text.p: Innotech Inc said it signed a letter of intent to establish a joint venture with Suzhou Medical Instruments Factory, or SMIF, based in Suzhou, China.
The joint venture would help market and distribute Innotech's Excalibur system as well as the joint venture's technology, products and systems in China, a new market for Innotech, the company said.
In exchange for equipment and licensing of certain technology rights and expertise, Innotech said it would own a majority of the joint venture.
The company said it expects the joint venture to be operational with sales posted during 1997 but did not disclose further details about the deal.
SMIF makes distributed ophthalmic apparatus and instrument equipment. Innotech makes lens products and desktop lens fabrication systems.
